facets.description: OAuth2GrantTypeFactory.getShortcut() javadoc suggests 3 letters, but decoding requires exactly 2 characters.
Shortcut length is not validated, allowing token IDs that the decoder rejects.
Null shortcuts are not validated and cause an NPE in DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.postInit, failing startup.
The new abstract getShortcut() method lacks a default, breaking existing custom factory implementations at compilation or runtime.
